clue.text: Travel authority gives vehicle approval

parts.note: a bus is a road vehicle
a pass is an approval, as an exam pass or a permit

explanation.surface: A transport official rubber-stamps a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A concession card is the document that authorises an older person to ride free on local transport.

clue.text: Good queen eats fish, too

indicators.note: the queen swallows the fish, holding it inside

parts.note: Good Queen Bess was the popular name for Elizabeth I
the ide is a freshwater fish, crossword favourite

explanation.surface: A virtuous queen also dines on fish.
explanation.walkthrough: Good Queen Bess is Elizabeth I of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: also, in addition.

clue.text: Odds to fix in spread

parts.note: SP is starting price, the betting odds at a race's start
to lay is to set or fix in place, as laying a carpet

explanation.surface: A bookmaker spreads bets after fixing the odds.
explanation.definitionFit: To splay is to spread out or turn outward, as splayed feet.

clue.text: Be present with soldier as escort

parts.note: to attend is to be present
a soldier ant is a kind of ant

explanation.surface: A soldier attends as someone's escort.
explanation.definitionFit: A companion or servant who accompanies someone.

clue.text: Did he write rapidly?

definitions.meaning: Jonathan ..., the author of Gulliver's Travels
fast, quickly, an old adverbial use

explanation.surface: A question about whether an author was a fast writer.
explanation.definitionFit: The satirist Jonathan shares a name with the word for fast.

clue.text: Eye-shield protecting Italian guest

indicators.note: the eye-shield wraps round and so protects the other piece placed inside it

parts.note: a visor shields the eyes

explanation.surface: A guest wears a sun visor to protect an Italian companion.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a caller or houseguest is someone who comes to stay or call.

clue.text: Invite lag to become security guard

indicators.note: the letters change to become something new

explanation.surface: An ex-convict is invited to take a job guarding a building.
explanation.walkthrough: A lag is a British slang term for a convict.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-appointed enforcer who guards a community outside the law.

clue.text: The way appearance gives you a bit of a lift

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
an air is a look or appearance, as an air of mystery

explanation.surface: A good look can lift someone's spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: A single step on a flight raises a climber a little.

clue.text: Greenish and quite sour, alas

indicators.note: an expression of woe signalling the letters are in distress and rearranged

explanation.surface: Something is pale green and unpleasantly tart.
explanation.definitionFit: A blue-green colour, named after the gemstone.

clue.text: What's left to regret about beaten side

indicators.note: the regret word goes around the other piece

parts.note: to rue is to regret

indicators.note: beaten letters are knocked about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone regrets that their team was defeated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beaten' is the anagram signal for the team word, and 'about' wraps the regret word round the result; the surface reads 'beaten side' as a defeated team.
explanation.definitionFit: The remainder after something is removed.

clue.text: Breaking up can be very painful

definitions.meaning: as in a headache so severe it seems to crack the head

explanation.surface: Ending a relationship can hurt a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from cleaving: parting apart, and a pounding headache described as cleaving the skull.

clue.text: Hanging is a bit of an embarrassment

indicators.note: only a portion of the following word is taken, the letters lying inside it

explanation.surface: A public hanging is somewhat embarrassing.
explanation.definitionFit: An arras is a tapestry wall hanging, named after the French town famous for weaving them.

clue.text: Make money abroad as a senior

parts.note: to do is to make or produce, as in do a drawing
the yen is Japanese currency, so foreign money

explanation.surface: A retiree earns cash overseas in old age.
explanation.definitionFit: The doyen of a group is its most respected and longest-serving member, its elder statesman.

clue.text: Win over, with circular argument?

definitions.meaning: to persuade someone to change their view
discussion going in a ring, the phrasal words taken literally

explanation.surface: Someone is persuaded by reasoning that goes round in circles.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means persuade; read literally it describes speech that circles without reaching a point.

clue.text: Feeling excitement

definitions.meaning: a physical perception, as of warmth or touch
a stir or thrill, as in causing a stir

explanation.surface: Someone feels a thrill.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a perception through the senses and a great public stir.

clue.text: The sea-god in his element here?

definitions.text: The sea-god in his element here?

parts.words: The sea-god in his element here?
parts.note: the Roman god of the sea gives his name to a chemical element, so he is literally in an element

explanation.surface: A sea deity is in his element.
explanation.definitionFit: Element 93 is named after the planet named for the Roman sea god.

clue.text: Deduce, we hear, girl is in hospital

indicators.note: the sound of the word is used, not its spelling

parts.note: to infer is to deduce
Mary is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A deduction that a girl is hospitalised.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a sick bay or a hospital ward.

clue.text: Southern fir needs trunk support

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for south or southern
pine and fir are both conifers, the setter using one for the other

explanation.surface: A conifer in the south needs its tree trunk propped up.
explanation.definitionFit: The backbone is the column that holds up the human torso.

clue.text: Closely following performance, including commercial

indicators.note: the performance contains the commercial inside it

parts.note: a showing is a screening or performance
an ad is a commercial

explanation.surface: A performance interrupted by an advert.
explanation.definitionFit: Tailing someone covertly, as a detective does.

clue.text: Work to break strike? Buzz off!.

indicators.note: the work piece breaks into the strike piece, sitting inside it

parts.note: to strike is to hit
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone sent to undermine a strike is told to go away.
explanation.definitionFit: A brusque British command to leave, like scram or clear off.

clue.text: Sing wordlessly to instrument-boring

parts.note: to hum is to sing without words
a drum is a percussion instrument

explanation.surface: Humming to a drum beat is dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Dull and monotonous, lacking any excitement.

clue.text: Release a chap who's beholden to none

parts.note: to release is to free
gent is short for gentleman, a chap

explanation.surface: A man is freed from obligations to anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unbound by contract or allegiance, especially a sportsman out of contract.

clue.text: Duet, say, to perform today in America

indicators.note: performing the letters puts them through a new routine

explanation.surface: A singer performs a duet in America today.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as the publication day of the American edition: a cheeky reference to the date.
explanation.definitionFit: The weekday named after Tiw, a weekday that would be today in the setter's timing.

clue.text: A super Tom is prepared — to kill Jerry?

indicators.note: the letters are made ready in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Tom the cartoon cat readies a trap for his mouse rival Jerry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is prepared' rearranges A SUPER TOM. Tom and Jerry are the cartoon cat and mouse, so Jerry is a mouse to be caught.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring device baited to catch rodents, Jerry being the cartoon mouse.

clue.text: Awaken girl-all right to go in

indicators.note: the second piece goes inside the first

parts.note: Eve is a girl's name
OK means all right

explanation.surface: A girl is roused and told it is fine to enter.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke a memory is to call it up or rouse it.

clue.text: We hear it's the height of irritation

indicators.note: the word is heard, not seen, so its sound counts

parts.note: the peak is the top, the height

explanation.surface: Someone at the height of annoyance.
explanation.definitionFit: Resentment or wounded pride, a fit of annoyance.

clue.text: Please donate a rib

definitions.meaning: an entreaty with the vocative 'O' and the verb meaning hand over
a diagonal vaulting rib in Gothic architecture

explanation.surface: A charity appeal asks for a rib to be given.
explanation.definitionFit: In architecture the term names a pointed arch or diagonal vault rib; split as two words it is a prayer-like plea to hand something over.

clue.text: Bury in hinterland

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the following word

explanation.surface: A burial in the hinterland.
explanation.definitionFit: To place a body in a grave.

clue.text: Animal whose horn found terrible

indicators.note: something terrible is in a bad state, so the letters are messed up

parts.note: the printed fodder is the word horn, which the setter meant to stand with the pronoun I as five letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A creature's horn is judged frightful.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as held lacks the word I that the anagram needs alongside HORN; most likely 'horn I found terrible' lost its I.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhinoceros is a large African and Asian beast, the short form common.

clue.text: Let off bill, left

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
quitted is the old past tense of quit, left

explanation.surface: Someone escapes paying a bill and leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A court that clears a defendant releases them without penalty.

clue.text: Foolish ritual, turning Eastern monarch into embalmed body

indicators.note: turning one piece into another means it goes inside it

parts.note: a mummy is an embalmed corpse
E is the abbreviation for east or eastern
R stands for rex or regina, a monarch

explanation.surface: An Eastern king is made into an embalmed corpse in a silly ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning ... into' places E and R inside MUMMY.
explanation.definitionFit: Pointless ceremony, from the mumming of masked players.

clue.text: Prematurely go round extremes of Greece with extreme enthusiasm

indicators.note: the first piece circles the other, enclosing it

parts.note: early means before the expected time

indicators.note: the first and last letters of the following word are taken

explanation.surface: Someone tours Greece too early with great keenness.
explanation.definitionFit: Keenly, with impatient desire to do something.
